feature: FILM-719 channel posting cadence (one slot per post, the scheduled job claims once; Shorts queue rules as FILM-2209 changed them)

mutations.name: C1 an episode's Shorts stop at the next episode's long video (FILM-2209: they spill past it)
mutations.pattern: places an episode’s Shorts after the next episode’s long video

mutations.name: C2 a release puts its Shorts ahead of Shorts already queued on the channel (FILM-2209: oldest first)
mutations.pattern: never puts a Short ahead of one already queued

mutations.name: C3 a day takes more posts than the channel's slots
mutations.pattern: counts a hand-scheduled post against its day

mutations.name: C4 long videos go back to back
mutations.find:
lastFull &&
        startOfLocalDay(
          addDays(
            localDate(lastFull, cadence.timezone),
            cadence.minDaysBetween,
          ),
          cadence.timezone,
        ),
mutations.pattern: go at least the channel’s days apart

mutations.name: G1 a Short goes before its long video is live
mutations.pattern: waits for the long video on its own channel

mutations.name: G2 a channel that has had its local day posts again
mutations.pattern: moves it and the Shorts queued after it

mutations.name: L1 two overlapping runs both claim a post
mutations.pattern: sends a post once when two runs overlap

mutations.name: DB1 two posts hold one slot
DB2 a cadence names another team's channel
E2E C5 a re-queued held Short goes ahead of the Shorts already queued (FILM-2209)
mutations.grep: re-queued to the end of the queue
